jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.summary: Build streaming and batch pipelines on Databricks and Snowflake for a Fortune 500 retail client.
responsibilities: Design Spark and dbt pipelines that move 4TB per day into a lakehouse.
Own data contracts, lineage and quality gates for downstream ML teams.
Mentor two mid-level engineers on the client delivery pod.
requirements: 7+ years in data engineering with production Spark experience.
Strong SQL plus Python; dbt and Airflow in production.
Databricks or Snowflake at enterprise scale.

jobs.title: Cloud Platform Engineer (AWS)
jobs.summary: Harden a multi-account AWS landing zone and cut deployment lead time for a healthcare payer.
responsibilities: Codify infrastructure with Terraform across 30+ AWS accounts.
Run the GitHub Actions and Argo CD delivery path for 12 product teams.
Instrument SLOs and on-call runbooks with OpenTelemetry.
requirements: 5+ years on AWS with Terraform module ownership.

jobs.title: Technical Recruiter - US IT Staffing
jobs.summary: Source and qualify US-based engineering candidates for enterprise staff augmentation roles.
responsibilities: Run full-cycle sourcing for cloud, data and application engineering requisitions.
Screen for visa status, rate expectation and technical depth before submission.
Keep the ATS clean so submission-to-interview ratios stay above 1 in 3.
requirements: 3+ years recruiting for the US IT staffing market.
Comfortable with W2, C2C and 1099 engagement models.
Excellent written English and US-shift availability.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer - LLM Applications
jobs.summary: Ship retrieval-augmented assistants for a banking client under model risk governance.
responsibilities: Build evaluation harnesses and guardrails for production LLM features.
Own retrieval quality: chunking, embeddings, reranking and caching.
Document model behaviour for the client's model risk management review.
requirements: 4+ years in ML engineering, 1+ year shipping LLM features.
Python, vector stores, and rigorous offline/online evaluation.
Financial services or other regulated-industry experience.
